הוא גוף כזה, שאינו יודע מה לעשות איתו, כן, כן, אז הוא אמר לו:

[“Kitzur,” it will be called “Kitzur”]

Like.. yo, every, every word there, every law, we will have

[By heart]

Yes

[Good, all right, we started now]

If only

[I made a handshake pledge with him, {we said}.. that he watches over me, and I watch over him]

Nu, and also, and also one needs to rise at midnight

[Midnight? Good, wait]

For this, also give a handshake pledge about midnight

[Good]

[He also said about midnight]

[About midnight, you wake me, and I wake you]

[Midnight]

[Give us a midnight lesson]

[I am not making a joke……]

{Apparently} everyone..

[We are finished, I am going to sleep]

All Tzfas will say: “What? What kind? What? Such Breslovers, we have not seen

They rise at midnight, study “Shulchan Aruch””

This is what the holy Rabbainu wants, that we be proficient; he said:

“On every day that one does not study “Shulchan Aruch,” even some se’if

At any rate, some se’if, each and every day some se’if or siman from “Shulchan Aruch” will be missing

This is {the segulah} of the soul, this..

He wanted us to be proficient in all, in all the “Turim” and in all the “Shulchan Aruch,” that we be proficient by heart

For this is the service of Hashem

And they gave their souls; with Rabbainu there were great, great ones of the world, not, not ordinary people

Master Kabbalists, Rebbe Yudel was a great miracle-worker, he was a great master Kabbalist, and a tzaddik and holy, but..

He, the holy Rabbainu, told him to speak with the limbs; he was complaining to Rabbainu

That his body, it..

[Wants everything]
